       p.title,
       p.abstract,

       p.venue,

JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE p.canonical_venue = 'EMNLP'

      )
  AND a.name ILIKE '%john%morri%'
ORDER BY p.citation_count DESC, p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

query: 2006, fabien cromieres, acl, translational innovation in medicine and complexity, sub sentential alignment using substring counts
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE p.year = 2006
  AND p.canonical_venue = 'ACL'
  AND LOWER(a.name) LIKE '%fabien%cromieres%'
  AND (
    LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%sub sentential alignment using substring counts%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%sub-sentential alignment using substring counts%'
    OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%translational innovation in medicine and complexity%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%sub sentential alignment using substring counts%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%sub-sentential alignment using substring counts%'
    OR LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%translational innovation in medicine and complexity%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE
     WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%sub sentential alignment using substring counts%' THEN 3
     WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%sub-sentential alignment using substring counts%' THEN 3
     WHEN LOWER(p.title) LIKE '%translational innovation in medicine and complexity%' THEN 3
     WHEN LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%sub sentential alignment using substring counts%' THEN 2
     WHEN LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%sub-sentential alignment using substring counts%' THEN 2
     WHEN LOWER(p.abstract) LIKE '%translational innovation in medicine and complexity%' THEN 2
     ELSE 1
   END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: semeval, rtm at semeval 2016 task predicting semantic referential translation machines related statistics, koc university
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.corpus_id,
       p.title,
       p.abstract,
       p.canonical_venue,
       p.venue,
       p.year,
       p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
LEFT JOIN AuthorInstitutions ai ON a.author_id = ai.author_id
LEFT JOIN Institutions i ON ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (
    (p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%rtm%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%rtm%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%semantic referential translation machine%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%semantic referential translation machine%')
    OR (p.title ILIKE '%task%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval 2016%')
)
AND (
    i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%koc university%'
)
ORDER BY
    (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semeval 2016%' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval 2016%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%referential translation machine%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%koc university%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
    p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%dependency parsing%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +

  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

   CASE WHEN a.name ILIKE '%ryan gabbard%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN i.display_name ILIKE '%university of pennsylvania%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
